The job of the function NvM_ReadAll shall restore the default data to the corresponding RAM blocks either if configured by the parameter NvMRom BlockDataAddress or by the parameter NvMInitBlockCallback, and set the error/status field in the administrative block to NVM_REQ_RESTORED_DEFAULTS when process- ing the extended runtime preparation.
